name: evidence-geo
lane: S8 - the congressional-district map for the PAC evidence tab + S8b (geocoding, ruling A)

request.source: 'csv' for an imported file, 'snapshot' for a saved FEC snapshot
request.id: the import id (csv-<32 hex>) or the snapshot directory name
request.committee: the pane's FEC committee id (C + 8 digits); required for a snapshot
request.cycle: REQUIRED and concrete (2024, 2023-2024, 2026). A blank or absent cycle is 400: a map is drawn on one Congress (ruling A).
request.direction: 'raised' (where the money came from) or 'spent' (where it went)

rules: Every dollar the source reports is either in a kind or in `unlocated`: located_total + unlocated_total == reported_total, to the cent.

A district key matches ^[A-Z]{2}-(\d{2}|AL|SEN)$ and a state key ^[A-Z]{2}$. A Senate seat keeps a district key and is drawn as the whole state; a presidential race has no district or state at all and goes to `unlocated`.
Every share is the row's share of its own kind's total and lies in 0..1.
Every kind states the basis that placed it, and `conversions` ships default_on false (S6_DESIGN ruling 12).
`stops` is the published legend scale and is never rewritten by the page.
Cycle 2022 draws the 118th map (Paul's 2026-09-17 correction to ruling 9).

RULING A (Paul, 2026-09-18: "There should be no all cycles, street address yes"). A map is drawn on ONE Congress, so `cycle` is always a concrete cycle and never blank. A request with a blank or absent cycle is refused 400 with a message naming the cycles the source carries; the map never answers with an empty country. The pane keeps "All cycles" for its own figures.

Every district and state row states the `basis` that placed it: `street` (an address the US Census geocoder matched, resolved through the shipped 2020-tract crosswalk), `zip` (the ZCTA crosswalk, one district), `zip_split` (a ZIP divided across districts by land area), or "" for a SPENT kind, whose basis is the candidate seat or the payee state and has nothing to do with a contributor address. A row placed only by street is never marked `split`.

`geocoded_rows`, `zip_rows` and `pending_rows` are DISJOINT counts of the raised rows read: placed by a cached street match, placed by ZIP (no usable address, an address the service could not place, or a census tract straddling two districts), and rows whose address could be geocoded but has not been. A SPENT map reads no contributor address and all three are 0. No row is ever dropped for want of a basis.

Contract v3 adds three WIDER layers, each folded from the same bucket tables the district layer draws, in Decimal, before rounding: `by_state` (one row per two-letter state), `by_region` (the four Census regions plus `Territories`, and `Unplaced` for a state the region table does not know) and, on a RAISED map only, `by_zip`.

Every wider layer reconciles. sum(by_state) == sum(by_region) == located_total, to the cent, so sum(by_state) + unlocated_total == reported_total. The page never re-aggregates: it draws the layer the route computed.

`by_zip` is capped at the 3,000 largest ZIPs and states what the cap cost: sum(by_zip) + zip_truncated_amount + zip_missing.amount == reported_total, to the cent. `zip_missing` is the rows with no readable five-digit ZIP; `zip_truncated` is how many ZIPs the cap dropped. A spent map reads no contributor ZIP and carries no by_zip rows at all.
Every by_state and by_region row carries its own `kinds` split, so turning a kind off on the page subtracts a number the SERVER computed rather than asking the browser to redo the geography.

`sides` states what each direction would report - {reported_total, rows, reason} for both raised and spent - computed from the rows alone, with no buckets, no boundary file and no crosswalk. The page opens on the side with money and disables the other with the route’s own refusal sentence as its title. sides[direction] always agrees with this payload about its own direction.

`zip_points_file` names the shipped pre-projected ZIP centre file (geo/zcta_points.json, the same 975x610 canvas as the boundary paths). A ZIP absent from it is NOT dropped: the page lists it under "Not placed on the map" with its dollars.
